text: In a village in the Bavarian Alps, Henry Frankenstein and his hunchbacked assistant Fritz [stitch a body together from fresh graves and the gallows|wrong|disturbing the dead], then raise it into a lightning storm atop his tower. Henry feels like God, but [the creature he has made|origin|monsters people made] is childlike, frightened of fire and chained in a dungeon. It escapes into the hills, where a game of tossing flowers on a lake [ends with a little girl drowned|who_suffers|young children], and the villagers [set the windmill ablaze around it|ending|the evil is destroyed].
